A Little Letter For You

I don't know if words will ever be enough to explain what you mean to me, but I wanted to try anyway — even if it comes out clumsier than it feels in my head.

Thank you for the ordinary Tuesdays that somehow felt like something worth remembering, just because you were in them. You have a way of making a plain afternoon feel like a good story.

I don't say this enough, so let me say it here: you make my life better in ways I'm still noticing. Your patience with me, your laugh at the worst jokes, the way you show up — none of it goes unnoticed.

I used to think I'd know when I was ready for forever. I didn't expect it to feel this quiet, this certain — just you, and the complete absence of doubt.

— Me, still figuring out how to say it right.
